name: web-chat
description: Embeddable, context-aware chat for web products — widget SDK, backend, and agent dashboard.

scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w packages/server && npm run build -w packages/widget-sdk && npm run build -w packages/dashboard
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run typecheck -w packages/server && npm run typecheck -w packages/widget-sdk && npm run typecheck -w packages/dashboard
